data.gender_notes: Fouziah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is victorious and triumphant. Derived from the Arabic word 'fuzah', meaning 'victorious' or 'triumphant'. The name Fouziah carries the meaning “Victorious, Triumphant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Fouziah usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious, triumphant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes strength, courage, and victory over challenges and hardships. Encourages the bearer to overcome obstacles and strive for success.
data.etymology: Fouziah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victorious, Triumphant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fouziah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Fouziah is a source of inspiration and pride for many Muslims, especially those who aspire to be successful and triumphant in their personal and professional lives. This name reflects the courage, resilience, and determination of Muslims who have faced adversity and emerged victorious. It also reminds us of the rich Islamic history filled with tales of triumph and glory, from the battles of Badr and Uhud to the stories of the Prophet Muhammad and his companions. Moreover, Fouziah is also a name that transcends national and ethnic boundaries, as it is embraced by Muslims around the world.
data.spiritual_significance: At a deeper level, the name Fouziah holds spiritual significance as a reminder of the ultimate victory that awaits us in the hereafter. It serves as a constant reminder that no matter what challenges we face in this world, we can find strength and comfort in our faith and the promise of Paradise. The name alsocalls us to strive for victory in our spiritual lives, to be victorious in our obedience to Allah and in our efforts to submit to His will. In short, Fouziah is a name that inspires us to be victorious not only in this world, but also in the next.
